summary: CollabSpace Iteration 2 verified end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 new pytest tests pass (health razorpay_live/storage_ready flags, /api/upload to Emergent Object Storage returning path+url+file_token, /api/files/{path} owner-only + admin-can-fetch + non-owner 403 + token query-param, /api/verifications creator-only + cross-user document rejected, GET /verifications/me, admin list with user enrichment + non-admin 403, PATCH reject records review_reason without flipping user.verified, PATCH approve sets user.verified=true, saved-searches create/list/isolation/non-owner-delete-404/owner-delete-200, Razorpay mock fallback returns order_MOCK<hex>+mock:true and verify accepts any signature). Existing 15/15 Iteration-1 tests still green (regression check on /api/influencers). Frontend: Dark navy + gradient CollabSpace login renders; brand@collabspace.app / Brand@123 lands on /discover showing all 4 seeded creators with cyan Verified pills on Riya/Arjun/Nikhil; horizontal chip row (16 chips) works; tapping the Fashion chip surfaces the 'Save this search' FAB with data-testid=save-search-fab (bottom-right cyan gradient); creator@collabspace.app profile shows the 'You are verified' banner (data-testid=verification-banner) which navigates to /verification with upload-id-button + verification-name-input + verification-instagram-input + verification-youtube-input + verification-notes-input; admin@collabspace.app lands on /admin with analytics tiles (Users 8 / Creators 4 / Brands 3 / Requests 5 / Deals 3 / Revenue ₹208) and the purple 'Verifications' quick-link (data-testid=admin-verifications-link) navigates to /admin-verifications rendering Pending/Approved/Rejected/All filter chips. React Native deprecation warnings detected: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (should migrate to boxShadow) — non-blocking, carried over from iteration 1.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — carried over from iteration 1, appears on multiple screens (login/discover/admin). Reference: files using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity in /app/frontend/app/**

action_items: Optional: migrate legacy shadow* StyleSheet props to boxShadow to silence React Native Web deprecation warnings (already noted in iteration 1).

Nice-to-have: add explicit testIDs on the verified badge (e.g. verified-badge-<user_id>) and on the /admin-verifications filter chips (e.g. verification-filter-pending) — visuals work but future automated tests will benefit.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~1380 lines but each feature block (uploads/verifications/saved-searches) is cleanly separated with section comments — acceptable, still readable.

Object storage helpers (init_storage / put_object / get_object) correctly cache storage_key, handle 503 by re-init, 402 by surfacing to client, and use run_in_threadpool from the async endpoints — good.
File-serving endpoint enforces ownership (owner_id == requester_id) OR admin role; short-lived HMAC file_token expires in 60 min — good.
POST /verifications enforces role='influencer' AND verifies the id_document_path belongs to the caller via db.files lookup — prevents cross-user doc reuse; test confirms 400 for cross-user.
PATCH /admin/verifications only flips users.verified=true on 'approved' (never on rejected) — verified by test_reject_does_not_flip_verified + test_approve_sets_verified_true.

Razorpay live/mock branching is correct: LIVE path uses razorpay.Client.order.create + HMAC_SHA256(order_id|payment_id, key_secret) verify; MOCK path returns order_MOCK<hex> with mock:true and skips signature check. is_mock is derived from payment.mock OR id.startswith('order_MOCK') — robust.
DELETE /saved-searches uses composite filter (search_id + user_id) so a non-owner correctly gets 404 without leaking existence — good pattern.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (new — 20 tests covering uploads, verifications, saved-searches, razorpay mock, regression)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added. Tests create TEST_-prefixed uploads/verifications/saved-searches/requests via APIs; cleanup fixture removes TEST_-prefixed saved-searches at run end. Riya Kapoor's verification record is left in the 'approved' state after tests — matches seeded verified=true so no visual impact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py runs in ~5s and uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Object storage is REAL (Emergent) — uploads persist and /api/files/{path} serves them with owner/admin ACL + optional file_token query param. Razorpay stays in MOCK because RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET are empty; setting them would flip health.razorpay_live to true and route create-order through razorpay-python SDK. UI testIDs added in iteration 2: save-search-fab, save-search-name-input, save-search-submit, saved-search-chip-*, verification-banner, verification-name-input, verification-instagram-input, verification-youtube-input, verification-notes-input, upload-id-button, verification-screen, admin-verifications-link. Filter chips on /admin-verifications are visually present (Pending/Approved/Rejected/All) but currently have no testID prefix — consider adding for future automation.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. Cross-user document reference is correctly blocked (400) and delete-non-owner correctly returns 404 to avoid leaking existence.
